gap.question: Are there any completed large-scale Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions (FMT, probiotics, defined consortia) in ICI-treated solid tumour patients reporting primary efficacy outcomes (OS/PFS/ORR)?
success_criteria: Identify any registered or completed Phase III RCTs of microbiome interventions combined with ICIs in solid tumors, or confirm their absence through clinical trial registry searches (ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP) and systematic review cross-referencing.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
